text: Dixon separates an enforceable limited assurance during negotiations from agreement on the final transaction. Read it with Drennan and Cyberchron when identifying exactly what reliance protects.
sourceSummary: A lender’s specific instructions to default while it considered a loan modification supported a promissory-estoppel claim, although the borrowers had no promise of a particular modified loan.
basis: Synthesis of the cited assigned excerpt.
